messages.subject: Project Harbor - SPA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Jonathan,

Please find our first draft of the share purchase agreement. Headline terms per the heads of terms. Note in particular clause 8 (limitations): our opening position is a 100% cap on the business warranties, a £41,500 de minimis and a £415,000 basket, with a 24-month general warranty period and 7 years for tax. We look forward to your mark-up.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
